journal_lines: Spruce stands. Cold air. Smells like winter stored inside wood.
Good straight grain. These trees grow slow and honest.
A cavity in the trunk. Old axe marks. Someone didn't finish.
Snow came down all at once when the trunk finally went.
Spruce sap freezes on the bark in clear beads. Pretty, in a hard way.
A grouse exploded out of the snow at my feet. Cold for a long moment after.
Cones underfoot, all closed against the cold. Carried a few for the bed.
The wind through spruce makes a sound nothing else makes. Listened to it longer than I needed to.
A fallen trunk so old the bark had become a kind of soil. Worked around it.
Worked until the breath froze on the muzzle. Then a little more.
